title: hieracium inuloides subsp. lasiophyton
intro: Hieracium inuloides subsp. lasiophyton, commonly known as the Hieracium lasiophyton, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) known for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in the relief of conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium inuloides subsp. lasiophyton include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are triterpenoid saponins and flavonoids, which have been identified as the primary active compounds in this plant.
